name: Alex
source:
Generally, Your Character is warm and supportive to their friends, tries to be brave despite the circumstances, and has a good heart to which their love interests are attracted. One of their deep secrets/insecurities is that they have felt a distance between their mother and themself ever since they were a kid. Your Character thinks that they are not quite what their mother was expecting, that they are disappointing, and it is deep-rooted in their core.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Your_Character_(Nightbound)]Wiki[/url]]
